crm_notes:
Summary: Enterprise legal discovery vendor looking to replace a brittle Elastic-based pipeline. Wants unified embeddings store + reranker layer for high-precision e-discovery and compliance search.

Workload and scale: internal estimate ~120M documents across litigation hold and regulatory archives; average doc length medium (4-12 pages). Expect 10-30k daily queries during investigations; peak/day bursts ~80k.

Performance targets: p50 <30ms (vector lookup), p95 end-to-end (lookup + rerank) target <150-200ms depending on route. Cost sensitivity: target effective cost-per-query $0.002-$0.01 depending on volume and reranking depth.

Model and infra preferences: prefer open embeddings (custom fine-tuned) and in-house reranker model. Need support for quantized/FP16 variants and ability to pin model versions. Want routing/fallback policies to cheaper models during heavy load.

Security/compliance: Must deploy in customer VPC or on-prem. KMS/HSM for key control, SSO via SAML, per-query audit logging retained 7-10 years, immutable retention controls, data residency (US only for some customers), and SOC2 + ISO27001 required. Discussed air-gapped export path for closed-case evidence.

POC scope (proposed): ingest 20M docs, run embedding pipelines, build ANN index, implement reranker pipeline for top-K candidates, measure p95 latency and cost-per-query across load profiles. Deliverables: benchmark report, security architecture doc, cost model.

Quotes/attitudes: CTO: 'We need a provable audit trail for every search — legal teams will demand it.' Lead ML: 'If reranking doubles latency, we need adaptive reranker routing.' AE notes: heavy procurement cycle; bring SOC2 docs early.

Immediate actions: schedule security deep-dive, confirm NDA, align on POC data hygiene steps (PII redaction), provide dedicated pricing for committed volumes.
poc_details: POC ingestion: 20M doc subset (cross-section of litigation, contracts, emails)
Indexing: CPU + GPU hybrid pipeline; build vector index with incremental updates
Reranking: top-200 retrieval -> lightweight cross-encoder rerank of top-10
Targets: p95 end-to-end <200ms on dedicated pool; cost per query estimate <$0.01 at POC scale
Security: VPC-hosted control plane, customer-managed KMS, audit logs to S3 with immutability flag
commercial_notes: Initial ARR ask estimate $300k-$900k. Prefers 12-24 month commitment if SLA and security acceptable. Procurement expects legal review by June 2026. Competitive pressure from Elastic + internal infra team. SE recommended Dedicated + Private combo for scale and control.
